svg.title: recusal: evidence in, one verdict out
svg.desc: A proposed tool call goes to checks, which return findings, and compute_verdict folds them into one verdict. A worst finding of WARNING or INFO gives PASS. A worst finding of ERROR gives RETRY. A worst finding of CRITICAL gives FAIL. The verdict drives the gate, the audit log and the failure classifier. No model is in the decision path.
